caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a dark brown finish, featuring four curved legs and a slightly domed lid with horizontal wood grain visible. The chest’s front panel is decorated with symmetrical, geometric patterns and star-like floral motifs in a lighter, yellowish color. There are two sets of these starburst designs, one on each side of the chest's central front panel, and each grouping contains four flower-like symbols. Between these groupings, there is a square frame outlined in the same yellow tone, filled with a four-part geometric pattern. Light yellow lines create a diamond shape on the panel, connecting the corners to the stars. The chest’s lid has a simple knotted piece of dark fabric or rope hanging over the edge at the center. The legs of the chest are carved with subtle, twisted detailing. The background is plain, off-white, and the artist's signature "M. PARISH" is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest
